id: 12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety
title: 激光系统紧急停机
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/12_Laser System Emergency Shut Down Innovative Laser Maintenance Laser Safety/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，指着一个红色大按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser cutting machine and points at a big red button.
shots.narration: 激光设备怎么紧急停机？

shots.scene: 地垫、按钮、闸刀开关三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a floor safety mat, a stop button and a wall knife switch. No people.
shots.narration: 三种办法：地垫、按钮、总闸。

shots.scene: 办公区门口，老李对着镜头讲话
shots.prompt_en: At an office door, the facility engineer talks to the camera.
shots.narration: 老李带客户参观激光车间。

shots.scene: 老李推门，带大家走向大型激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the door and leads the visitors toward a large laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 边走边讲紧急停机。

shots.scene: 访客们好奇地看着车间里正在工作的机器
shots.prompt_en: Visitors look curiously at the working machines in the workshop.
shots.narration: 客户来了，都想看看我们在做什么。

shots.scene: 老李笑着张开手臂欢迎
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smiles and opens his arms in welcome.
shots.narration: 我们也乐意展示给他们看。

shots.scene: 几位访客弯腰凑到激光机前往里看
shots.prompt_en: Several visitors bend over and lean close to the front of the laser machine to look inside.
shots.narration: 走到激光机前，人人第一件事——

shots.scene: 访客的脸几乎贴到机器前面
shots.prompt_en: A visitor's face is almost pressed to the front of the machine.
shots.narration: 就是凑到跟前去看。

shots.scene: 激光机前铺着一条长长的黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: A long black safety mat lies on the floor in front of the laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机器前面铺着这条安全地垫。

shots.scene: 老李沿着地垫走，然后站上去
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the mat and then steps onto it.
shots.narration: 只要一踩上去，

shots.scene: 示意图：脚踩上地垫，机器所有运动图标停止
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a foot steps on the mat and all the machine's motion icons stop. No people.
shots.narration: 整台机器立刻停止。

shots.scene: 地垫图标和盾牌图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A floor mat icon connected to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是机器上最重要的保护之一。

shots.scene: 操作台上并排一个红色急停按钮和一个黄色快停按钮
shots.prompt_en: On the operator console, a red emergency stop button sits next to a yellow quick stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 停机按钮有两种：急停和进给保持。

shots.scene: 老李走到机器末端，指着另一个按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the far end of the machine and points at another button.
shots.narration: 操作台上有，机器末端也有。

shots.scene: 按下快停，龙门架停住，电源指示灯仍亮
shots.prompt_en: The quick stop button is pressed; the gantry freezes while the power indicator lights stay on. No people.
shots.narration: 进给保持是快停，

shots.scene: 运动箭头被暂停符号挡住
shots.prompt_en: A motion arrow blocked by a pause symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 只中断机器的运动。

shots.scene: 老李手按操作台上的红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the red emergency stop button on the console.
shots.narration: 急停就不一样了。

shots.scene: 驱动、高压等图标一起熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Icons for motor drives, high voltage and everything else switch off together. No people.
shots.narration: 驱动、高压，全部断开。

shots.scene: 老李转身穿过门边，经过储罐和冷水机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns and walks past a cryogenic tank and a chiller.
shots.narration: 要是出了事故，

shots.scene: 一个新操作员图标头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a new operator with question marks above his head. No people.
shots.narration: 新操作员又不知道该怎么办，

shots.scene: 老李走到墙边的闸刀开关前，伸手指着
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reaches a big knife disconnect switch on the wall and points at it.
shots.narration: 那就拉下这个总隔离开关。

shots.scene: 闸刀被拉下
shots.prompt_en: The knife switch handle is pulled down. No people.
shots.narration: 总闸一拉，

shots.scene: 激光器、冷水机、辅助设备图标一起熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the laser, the chiller and all support equipment go dark together. No people.
shots.narration: 激光器、冷水机和辅助设备全断电。

shots.scene: 老李站在总闸旁，对镜头竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the disconnect switch and raises one finger to the camera.
shots.narration: 如果你还要花时间想一想，

shots.scene: 思考气泡被划掉，箭头指向闸刀开关
shots.prompt_en: A thinking bubble is crossed out and an arrow points to the knife switch. No people.
shots.narration: 那就直接拉闸。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现地垫、两个按钮、闸刀开关图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a safety mat, two stop buttons and a knife switch.
shots.narration: 地垫一踩全停，进给保持停运动。

shots.scene: 红色急停按钮和闸刀开关
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button and a knife switch side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 急停全断，拿不准就拉总闸。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在总闸旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the wall disconnect switch.
shots.narration: 紧急停机就讲到这里，下次见！
